summary: m1-wayland groundwork patches (source only; host-tested; not SDK-compiled/staged/booted)

sfgop-fail-closed.patch.abi: SFGOPFramebuffer unchanged: 64 bytes, align 8, offsets address 16, size 24, width 32, bpp 44, componentMasks 52 (_Static_assert + host test)
behaviour: short GetCurrentDisplayMode / IOPixelInformation replies fail closed
SFGOPPresent only for IOVirtIOGPU, else KERN_NOT_SUPPORTED with no driver call

kind via IOObjectConformsTo in the form of the IOKit surface SFGOP is compiled against: tiny SFIOKitLib.h (_SF_IOKITLIB_H) 3-argument status with boolean_t*; CF iokituser IOKitLib.h (#else) 2-argument boolean; a failed or unknown query fails open()

iogop-vram-write-combine.patch.gate: platform nub (not IOPCIDevice) AND device-tree root compatible contains AppleARM
effect: sf-vram-write-combine=true -> IOFramebufferUserClient maps kIOFBVRAMMemory with kIOMapWriteCombineCache (Normal-NC on DRAM)

cache_attribute_findings.framebuffer: 0xbd5d5c000+0xfa0000; ADT /chosen dram-base 0x800000000 dram-size 0x400000000 => is_dram_addr; not pa_valid; no pmap-io-ranges cover (109 entries)
cache_attribute_findings.mapping_types: default and kIOMapInhibitCache -> VM_WIMG_IO -> Device-GRE (MAIR 0x0D) on DRAM; kIOMapWriteCombineCache -> VM_WIMG_WCOMB -> Normal-NC (MAIR 0x40) on DRAM
cache_attribute_findings.correctness: Device memory faults on unaligned access and DC ZVA, hazardous for direct-render compositors and /dev/fb0 unaligned writes (EFAULT via copyio recovery). Device vs Normal-NC aliases have no cacheable alias and no coherency loss, only cross-alias ordering; acceptable with one-owner hand-off.
cache_attribute_findings.w3: IOFramebuffer fVramMap stays Device-GRE; kernel console uses aligned stores and 16-byte-multiple row bcopy (works, slow scroll); WC there would need a shared IOGraphics change, deferred

deferred: W1 wlroots 10-bit primary format (Sway baseline only)

A_tiny_static.matching: char* IOServiceMatching; IOServiceGetMatchingService(master, char*, io_service_t*) -> status
